description: This file defines the Zend_Exception class, which extends the built-in Exception class to provide additional functionality specific to the Zend Framework, including compatibility for PHP versions prior to 5.3.0, custom string representation, and support for chaining previous exceptions.

classes.name: Zend_Exception
classes.description: A custom exception class for Zend Framework that extends the base PHP Exception class, adding support for previous exceptions and customized string output based on PHP version

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Zend_Exception, with compatibility handling for PHP versions before and after 5.3.0

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls; specifically provides access to getPrevious() via magic method for PHP < 5.3.0

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, including chained previous exceptions on PHP versions before 5.3.0

methods.name: _getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the stored previous exception object, used internally by the class
